physical.title: trousers
physical.summary: A pair of man's short leather trousers; summer wear.  Shaped into a point at middle back; chevron-shaped decoration below, using brown and tan pigment and blue woven cloth (latter much worn).  Fastened with leather drawstring.  Front panel has alternating bands of pigment (as before) and two strips of cloth: red tabby woollen cloth and beige/cream printed tabby cotton cloth, latter extending to waistline.  Embellished with (interrupted) lines of transparent, light brown and black glass beads.  Four identical human figures, in black pigment, painted at top sides (back panel) and lower sides (triangular-shaped panel).

physical.title: trousers; underpants
physical.summary: A pair of woman's trousers, or underpants, made of leather, and decorated with beads and metal discs.  Upper front panel decorated with black, white and turquoise glass (?) beads stitched onto strips of brown and green tabby cotton (?) cloth.  An additional bead encrusted rectangular leather panel stitched to lower third of trousers, with an oval flap at each side.  Almost completely covered in strings of couched beads; a row of silver-coloured round metal discs at hemline.  Larger strung blue and green beads suspended from bottom edge.  Long leather fringing at hemline of main trousers.  Leather drawstring.

cultural.vision_reason: A leather and wool coat with hair fringe, geometric appliqué, and bead trim, consistent with Siberian reindeer-herding peoples such as the Evenki; nothing contradicts the attribution and the construction matches known Evenki/Tungusic garment style.

physical.title: coat
physical.summary: A man's (?) coat; knee-length.  Made of leather, cloth and hair.  Waisted: upper section made of leather, collar.  Strips of blue tabby cotton cloth applied to edge of centre front opening, waistline, shoulders and upper back.  Latter has large-scale appliqué geometric pattern.  Interrupted line of light brown glass beads stitched on top of blue cloth.  Red leather stitched in lines parallel to cloth; cream thread (animal derived) clearly visible.  Below waistline coat made of red tabby woven wool cloth, hand spun and hand woven (dyed in the piece?).  Further applied cloth and leather at centre back; red and blue bands applied to lower sleeve.  Long, coarse hair knotted to hemline; hair also knotted to shoulder back, at sides.  Small holes at right elbow (as worn).
